admin.title: Ranks
admin.help: Manage each group’s rank banner here. The default style uses icon + color + name, or upload a custom horizontal image like XenForo.
admin.icon_help: Font Awesome class, e.g. fas fa-star
admin.label_help: Leave empty to use the rank name.
admin.image_help: PNG, JPG, GIF or WEBP. Max 1 MB. Transparent PNG recommended.
admin.guest_note: The Guest group is never shown as a banner.
